hook: AI gave you a 9-step framework when you asked a yes/no question. Again.
caption:
AI gave you a 9-step framework when you asked a yes/no question. Again.

Here's what's actually happening:

The model doesn't know if you're a "just tell me the answer" person or a "walk me through the reasoning" person. So it defaults to: comprehensive. Thorough. Exhaustive.

Which is great if you love reading.

But if your brain works in fast decisions and bullet points, that wall of text isn't helpful — it's friction. You either skim it, miss something important, or just close the tab and guess anyway.

The fix isn't reprompting every single time with "be more concise" like you're scolding a golden retriever.

The fix is teaching the AI how your brain actually processes information — once — so it stops explaining things to you like you're writing a thesis when you're just trying to make a Tuesday decision.

Some people need the 9 steps. Genuinely. They want the full picture before they move.

You're probably not that person. And that's valid.

BootFile builds your thinking profile so the AI already knows which one you are before you type a single word.

No more "be concise." No more reformatting the answer yourself. Just responses that actually match how your brain works.
